verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Stripe hosts an llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and provides machine-readable .md versions of docs pages (e.g., terminal.md), directly enabling an agent to be pointed at agent-oriented documentation. This is corroborated by first-party docs referencing agent-first tooling and an MCP server for AI agents to query documentation. Missing for 10: no independent third-party report of an agent successfully consuming these docs end-to-end.
